subject.title: fix: control UI locale PRs fail to arm auto-merge

question: Should Control UI locale refresh remain on current main's direct-commit workflow, or should maintainers restore a reviewable generated-PR workflow that requires Mantis `contents: write` and auto-merge?
rationale: The submitted branch fixes a historical generated-PR workflow, while current main has a materially different direct-publication implementation; only the responsible owner can confirm whether that replacement was intentional and acceptable.

options.title: Keep direct publication
options.body: Treat the current `plan`/`refresh` direct-commit workflow as the intended replacement and close this obsolete permission change.

options.title: Restore generated PR publication
options.body: Rebase a focused replacement onto current main, explicitly restore the generated-PR contract, and demonstrate an end-to-end locale PR with auto-merge armed.

recommendation.title: Keep direct publication
recommendation.body: Treat the current `plan`/`refresh` direct-commit workflow as the intended replacement and close this obsolete permission change.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main file history shows repeated ownership of the Control UI locale workflow and its follow-up behavior.
